raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.4.1"

package:
  name: marisa-trie
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/m/marisa-trie/marisa_trie-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 44ce3bdbeb7c950d463e460184fc3e18702df9ef0edb826bac672fd789fb1d20

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - cython
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - marisa_trie
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - hypothesis
        - pytest-run-parallel
        - readme_renderer
    files:
      source:
        - tests/
    script:
      env:
        # increase hypothesis health check leniency
        CI: "1"
      content:
        - pytest

about:
  license_file: LICENSE
  license: MIT AND (BSD-2-Clause OR LGPL-2.1-or-later)
  summary: Static memory-efficient & fast Trie-like structures for Python (based on marisa-trie C++ library)
  homepage: https://github.com/pytries/marisa-trie
  repository: https://github.com/pytries/marisa-trie
  documentation: https://marisa-trie.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  feedstock-name: python-marisa-trie
  recipe-maintainers:
    - kmike
    - superbobry
    - mariusvniekerk
    - mgorny
